messages:
ravi: Heads up — rolling nvidia-driver 535.90 across eu-west-1 failed on ~30% of GPU nodes. Nodes rebooted but stayed in provisioning. DKMS/depmod errors in cloud-init. Reverting the package for now. Any quick wins?

maddy: also seeing ~12 nodes in eu-west-1a and 6 in eu-west-1b. Kernel 5.15.0-70-generic.

lee: pasting the common failure snippet from one node:
```
DKMS: build error for nvidia-535-535.90
make[1]: Entering directory '/var/lib/dkms/nvidia/535.90/build'
ERROR: modpost: "nvidia_uvm_module_init" [nvidia.ko] undefined!
/var/lib/dkms/nvidia/535.90/build/module/nvidia_uvm.o:(.text+0x1f): undefined reference to `get_nvlink_topology'
make[1]: *** [modules] Error 1
```

ravi: dmesg also shows NVLINK device mismatch and failed peer registration: "NVRM: NVML peer init failed: -22"

sam: quick root cause hypothesis — DKMS is rebuilding against a containerized gcc/headers mismatch during cloud-init; looks like host kernel-headers absent or wrong symlink. Found nodes where /lib/modules/$(uname -r)/build -> missing.

lee: quick remedial command we ran on a repro node that fixed build:
```
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y linux-headers-$(uname -r) build-essential && sudo dkms autoinstall
```

katie: cordoned the affected nodes and shifted pods to us-west. Notified two Dedicated pools that dipped under performance SLA (ops ticket created).

deploy-bot: rollback of nvidia-driver 535.90 package to 535.54 triggered by ravi at 1802512410 :package_rollback: 

ops-bot: repro job queued in staging with kernels [5.15,5.19,6.1] and full DKMS log capture. Job id: job-1802512500

maddy: temporary mitigation — pin drivers in apt repo and block automated upgrades on gpu-* instance group until we verify.

ravi: action items: 1) hold 535.90 in repo; 2) run DKMS build matrix across kernels in staging; 3) ensure linux-headers are present in cloud-init; 4) add preflight check for nvlink/nv_peer_mem devices. I'll open a formal incident and link cluster inventories.

katie: I'll send short CS blurb and update status page. Thanks team :thumbsup:

lee: created a short script to detect at-risk nodes and print missing items, pushed to infra-tools repo: scripts/check-gpu-dkms-compat.sh

sam: follow-up — also check GCC version used during cloud-init containerized steps. We saw gcc-7 symlink on a couple of images causing symbol mismatch.

ravi: keeping this thread open until staging verifies. If you have repro logs, drop them here or in the job artifact. Thanks.
